clue.text: Everyone filling favoured platform

blocks.note: a pet is a favoured one, as in teacher's pet
everyone is all

explanation.surface: A crowd packs onto a stage reserved for the favoured few.
explanation.definitionFit: A pallet is a flat wooden base used for stacking and moving goods, a kind of low platform.

clue.text: Person in court‘s simple dispute

blocks.note: plain means simple or unadorned
a tiff is a minor quarrel

explanation.surface: Someone appearing in a courtroom is caught up in a straightforward quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The plaintiff is the party who brings a lawsuit, so is one of the people appearing before the judge.

clue.text: Endlessly weak victim is sucker

indicators.note: without an end means the final letter of the word that follows is cut off

blocks.note: lame means weak or feeble, as in a lame excuse
prey is a victim of a hunter

explanation.surface: A permanently feeble victim turns out to be a gullible fool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sucker' reads as a dupe, but here it is a creature that attaches by suction.
explanation.definitionFit: The lamprey is an eel-like fish that latches onto other fish with a round sucking mouth.

clue.text: Lavish times tucking into tuna battered with beer

indicators.note: tucking into something means going inside it, so one piece is placed within the other
battered things are knocked out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: X is the multiplication sign, read as times
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A recipe for fish in beer batter served up in generous portions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Battered' suggests fish in batter, but it signals mixing the letters; the times sign then goes in after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Exuberant can mean profuse or abundant, as in exuberant growth, matching lavish in the sense of plentiful.

clue.text: Scout striking out hit and fought

indicators.note: striking something out crosses it off, and here the word out itself is what gets removed

blocks.note: taken as written
rapped means struck sharply

explanation.surface: A boy scout lashed out and got into a brawl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Striking out' looks like the scout swinging a punch; instead the letters OUT are struck from Scout, leaving SC.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrap is informal for to brawl or quarrel, so scrapped is a past-tense synonym of fought.

clue.text: Opposing method raised in meeting

blocks.note: convening is coming together, a meeting
an art is a method or knack

explanation.surface: At a meeting, someone stands up to propose an alternative procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: Contravening means going against or violating a rule, so acting in opposition to it.

clue.text: Drink all tips away, waste gin

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drinker tips everything out and pours the gin away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tips' sounds like pouring; it means the first and last letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling white wine from Piedmont in northern Italy.

clue.text: Experts upset salesman, 20

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the word is read upwards

blocks.note: pros are professionals, experts
a rep is a sales representative

explanation.surface: Professionals have annoyed a travelling salesman.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the answer to 20 Down, BLOSSOM, used as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To blossom is to develop and flourish, so it means to thrive or do well.

clue.text: Variable excluded by inactive people to become active ones

indicators.note: excluded means left out, so that letter is removed from the following word

blocks.note: dozers are people who doze, idle sleepers
algebra uses x, y and z as variables

explanation.surface: Drop one uncertain factor and lazy people turn into busy ones.
explanation.walkthrough: Z comes out of DOZERS. The surface plays on the two being opposites.
explanation.definitionFit: Doers are people who get things done rather than just talking about them, energetic types.

clue.text: One loved pinning rook covering for knight

indicators.note: pinning something holds it fast within, so one piece sits inside the other

blocks.note: an amour is a loved one or love affair
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: A chess scene where a beloved piece pins the rook while covering the knight.
explanation.walkthrough: R is held inside AMOUR, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval knight wore a suit of metal plates as protection for the body in battle.

clue.text: Gap in timber that’s broken reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said or heard, so the sound matters rather than the spelling

blocks.note: something broken is not whole

explanation.surface: A carpenter notices a hole in a plank that seems to be cracked.
explanation.definitionFit: A knothole is the opening left in a board where a knot in the wood has fallen out.

clue.text: Way hard parts of earth disintegrated

indicators.note: parts here is a verb, splitting the other piece apart so something sits in its middle
something disintegrated falls to bits, so its letters are scattered and rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
rough means harsh or hard

explanation.surface: Tough fragments of soil have crumbled away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Parts of earth' reads as soil fragments; parts is a verb splitting the anagram of OF EARTH.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoroughfare is a main road or public route through a place, so a way in the sense of a road.

clue.text: Fish treats — pay attention

blocks.note: to nurse a patient is to treat them
hark is an old command to listen

explanation.surface: Someone offering titbits to a pet fish urges it to listen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fish treats' reads like food for fish; Fish is the definition and treats is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The nurse shark is a slow bottom-dwelling shark of warm coastal waters, a species of fish.

clue.text: Work soap suds with occasional scrubbing

indicators.note: scrubbing out every other letter, occasionally, leaves alternate ones behind

blocks.note: the even-placed letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A cleaning chore with soapy suds and the odd bit of scrubbing.
explanation.definitionFit: An opus is a musical or literary composition, especially one numbered in a composer's catalogue.

clue.text: Climber picked up medical supply

indicators.note: picked up means heard, as a radio picks up a signal, so we go by sound

blocks.note: an IV is an intravenous drip supplying fluid to a patient

explanation.surface: A mountaineer collects medical provisions before the ascent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Climber' suggests a mountaineer; it is a climbing plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivy is an evergreen plant that clings to walls and trees as it grows upward.

clue.text: Come tenth (before some characters) after holding first in race for so long …

indicators.note: holding something means having it inside, so one piece is put within another
first in means only the opening letter of the next word is kept

blocks.note: to come is to arrive
deci- is the prefix for a tenth, placed before some letters of a word, as in decilitre
the opening letter of race

explanation.surface: A runner arrives tenth, having briefly led the race, and the ellipsis leads on to the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The parenthesis says the tenth is a metric prefix, written before other characters, as in decimetre.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrivederci is the Italian farewell, used much like goodbye or see you later in English.

clue.text: Sign of enmity straddling toilet, try potty with kid

indicators.note: straddling means sitting astride, so one piece spreads either side of the other
potty means crazy, so the letters are mixed up

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
loo is British slang for a toilet

explanation.surface: Toilet training a toddler, with the kid perched on a potty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Potty' plays on toilet training; it means crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirty look is a scowl or glare that shows hostility toward someone without words.

clue.text: Figures entering in cathedral city with a vengeance

indicators.note: entering means going into something, so one piece is placed within the others

blocks.note: taken as written
tens are numerical figures
Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England

explanation.surface: Numbers flood into a cathedral city with fury.
explanation.walkthrough: Entering applies to the figures, which slip between the word in and the city.
explanation.definitionFit: With a vengeance is an idiom meaning to an extreme degree, forcefully or fiercely.

clue.text: … expected winner that might make face-plant?

blocks.note: the face is the front
a runner is a creeping plant shoot, or the runner bean

explanation.surface: The race favourite might fall flat and plant a face in the dirt.
explanation.walkthrough: Face-plant reads as a tumble; split it into face and plant. The question mark flags the runner as an example of a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A frontrunner is the leading contender in a race or contest, the one most people think likely to win.

clue.text: Part involved in examination of circuit

indicators.note: involved in means enclosed within, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: an oral is a spoken exam
a bit is a part

explanation.surface: A component plays a role in testing an electrical circuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Circuit' suggests electronics, but here it means a path around a planet.
explanation.definitionFit: Orbital is the adjective for an orbit, the circular path one body traces around another.

clue.text: Deed trapping this winged beast would be discussed

indicators.note: the clue says the deed trapping the answer would make the next word, so removing the deed's letters from that word leaves what was trapped

blocks.note: debated means discussed
taken as written

explanation.surface: A legal deed concerning a flying creature becomes a matter of discussion.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: put the answer inside the deed and you get a word for discussed, so the answer is what is left when the deed is taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: The bat is the only mammal capable of true flight, using wings of stretched skin.

clue.text: See small plant coming up beneath black flower

indicators.note: coming up in a down clue means rising, so the letters are read from bottom to top
beneath in a down clue places what follows above the rest

blocks.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
lo is an old word meaning look or see
moss is a tiny non-flowering plant

explanation.surface: A gardener spots a tiny seedling sprouting under a dark bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A blossom is a flower, especially the bloom on a fruit tree in spring.

clue.text: Young bee piercing brown horse

indicators.note: piercing something means going into it, so one piece lies inside the other

blocks.note: a bay is a reddish-brown horse
bee is the spelt-out name of the letter B

explanation.surface: A young bee stings a chestnut-coloured horse.
explanation.walkthrough: B goes inside BAY. 'Young bee' looks like a single phrase, but Young is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Young as a collective noun means offspring, and a baby is a newborn offspring.

clue.text: Extra posh type elevated above you and me

indicators.note: elevated in a down clue means lifted up, so the word reads upwards
above in a down clue puts the first piece over the second

blocks.note: a nob is an upper-class person, a toff
us is you and me

explanation.surface: A toff considers themselves above ordinary folk.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonus is an additional payment or benefit on top of what is expected.

clue.text: Time after strain, have ramshackle place to live

indicators.note: after tells us the piece for time goes behind the piece for strain

blocks.note: a strain is a tune, and a shanty is a sailors' work song
T is the abbreviation for time
to own is to have

explanation.surface: After a period of stress, a person ends up in run-down lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strain' suggests stress; here it means a melody.
explanation.definitionFit: A shanty town is a settlement of crude makeshift shacks, typically on a city's edge.

clue.text: Drain alcohol after removing top

indicators.note: the top of a down entry is its first letter, which is taken off

blocks.note: booze is informal for alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Pour the drink down the sink after taking the cap off.
explanation.definitionFit: To drain can mean to seep or trickle slowly out, which is what a liquid does when it oozes.

clue.text: Avoiding terrible rip-off, inflation-proof plastic is fanciful

indicators.note: avoiding something means leaving it out, so those letters are removed
terrible suggests the following word is mangled, so its letters may appear in any order before removal
plastic material can be moulded into any shape, so the remaining letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A sceptic says a scam-free plastic card that beats inflation is pure fantasy.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove R, I, P, O, F, F from INFLATIONPROOF to leave NLATIONO, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Notional means existing only as an idea or in theory, so imaginary rather than real.

clue.text: Mostly seafood covering over light dish

blocks.note: a mussel is a shellfish
O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: A seafood starter with a topping served over a delicate plate.
explanation.walkthrough: MUSSEL loses its final L, then wraps around O after the M.
explanation.definitionFit: A mousse is an airy whipped preparation, sweet or savoury, made light by beaten egg or cream.

clue.text: Joined classes older educator holds

indicators.note: holds means the run of words contains the letters within it

blocks.note: the letters run across the end of classes, all of older and the start of educator

explanation.surface: A veteran teacher takes charge of more senior groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldered means fused with molten metal alloy, a way of making a permanent metal bond.

clue.text: Nuisance occupying loft that’s insufficient

explanation.surface: A pest has moved into the attic, which is not good enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loft' looks like an attic, but it is the verb meaning to hit high.
explanation.definitionFit: Skimpy means meagre or scanty, providing too little of something such as fabric or food.
